title: Dispatch: olc5.8 event-anchored cooldowns + soft-limit hook landing (attempt 1)
description:
Implements capability eshyra-olc5.8 (read it and parent eshyra-olc5 notes on the capability contract: operation, inputs, exclusions, residual DM interpretation, real pack binding, provider-neutral execution, state effects, conformance tests exercising the PACK representation, fail-closed). Branch eshyra-olc5.8.1 from eshyra-olc5.8 at origin/main e25b29cd. Model gpt-6-luna.

CURRENT STATE (verified by captain):
- Pack (from PR #656): economies[].cooldown.startsOn = {event:'grant-ended',grantId} | {event:'state-entered',stateId}; validated in packages/core/src/rules/magicItemMechanics.ts (~868, ~2520). Producers: COOLDOWN_ANCHORS + efreetiStopper in packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/magicItemTriage.ts (~955, ~1540, hook at ~1582); cooldown() helper in magicItemUseEconomies.ts (~95-108).
- Runtime ignores startsOn: itemState.ts scheduleEconomyAfterSpend (~1760-1827) sets availableAt at SPEND time when remaining hits 0. itemResetExecutor.ts (~650-700) recharges when elapsed >= availableAt and skips economies with no availableAt. Timer transitions resolve in itemResetExecutor resolveDueItemClockEvents (~970) via itemTimers.ts.
- Soft limit already implemented: itemState.ts ~2146 (cost.onExhausted === 'risk-adjudicated' -> exhausted pool spends 0, no refusal). Dawn/long-rest resets exist (resolveRestEventItemResets ~1008, resolveDueItemClockEvents).
- Readiness: a clause is green only when every engineHook key is in LANDED_MAGIC_ITEM_ENGINE_HOOKS (magicItemCompiler.ts ~345; currently only F5 'duration-budget accounting'). Operation readiness: packages/core/src/state/itemExecutionReadiness.ts assertMagicItemOperationReady / deriveItemOperationReadinessInput.
- Items on hook F5 'elapsed-time cooldown reset' (7): Frost Brand (1 hour), Horn of Valhalla (7 days), Rod of Security (10 days), Well of Many Worlds (1d8 hours) [initiation-anchored]; Wings of Flying (1d12 hours, startsOn state-entered 'inactive'); Ring of Djinni Summoning (24h, grant-ended 'particular-djinni'); Efreeti Bottle stopper (24h, grant-ended 'serving-efreeti'). Soft-limit: Ring of X-ray Vision (F7 'long-rest reset and early-reuse gate'), Wind Fan (F5 'dawn reset with nonblocking early-reuse risk').

CAPTAIN DESIGN (follow it; if any part proves wrong, stop and report instead of improvising):
1. Hook split in the importer, no pack SHAPE change: initiation-anchored cooldowns keep 'elapsed-time cooldown reset'; state-entered anchored get F5 'state-anchored cooldown reset'; grant-ended anchored get F5 'grant-anchored cooldown reset'. Derive the hook from startsOn (not a per-item list) so a new anchored economy can't silently inherit the wrong hook.
2. Runtime, anchored economies: at spend, an economy whose cooldown has startsOn spends normally (remaining 0) but is NOT scheduled (no availableAt) - it is "awaiting anchor"; reset executor already leaves it depleted. New internal function in itemState (or a small new module) e.g. applyItemCooldownAnchorEvent(db, {instanceId, packRef}, event: {event:'state-entered',stateId}|{event:'grant-ended',grantId}, rng?) that, for each economy whose startsOn matches AND which is awaiting anchor (cooldown kind, remaining 0, no availableAt), sets availableAt = elapsedNow + duration (dice durations rolled with the seeded rng; fail closed with an ItemStateError if dice and no rng). Matching but not-awaiting economies are untouched (initial state entry, never-spent item, already scheduled). Return evidence of what was scheduled. Unknown grantId/stateId for this record -> fail closed.
3. Wire state-entered LIVE: every place an item state transition is committed (use_item operation transitions in itemState useItem, and timer transitions in resolveDueItemClockEvents) calls the anchor function for the entered state, in the same transaction, with the elapsed time of the transition (for a timer, the deadline/boundary elapsed minutes, so a late clock advance does not shorten or lengthen the wait - nonzero-elapsed scenario). Initial state at createInitialItemState must NOT schedule.
4. grant-ended: implement and test the function path, but there is no live grant lifecycle yet (owned by eshyra-olc5.12). Do NOT land the grant-anchored hook; add a code comment and completion note that olc5.12 must call applyItemCooldownAnchorEvent on grant end and land 'grant-anchored cooldown reset' then. Ring of Djinni / Efreeti stay engine-pending.
5. Land in LANDED_MAGIC_ITEM_ENGINE_HOOKS, each with a short reviewed-contract comment like the existing one: 'elapsed-time cooldown reset', 'state-anchored cooldown reset', F7 'long-rest reset and early-reuse gate', F5 'dawn reset with nonblocking early-reuse risk'. Before landing each, confirm the runtime fully owns that hook's contract for EVERY economy carrying it (spend, schedule, recharge; soft-limit zero-balance reuse permitted and reset restores the safe use). If any carrier is not fully owned, do not land that hook and report why.
6. Regenerate the pack (importer + verify-dnd5e-srd-pack + inventory --check per docs/importer-fix-protocol.md). Report the EXACT ready-operation delta: run deriveItemOperationReadinessInput + assertMagicItemOperationReady over all item x variant x operation combos before and after (19 ready today). For every newly-ready operation, state why its full printed behavior is faithfully executed or remains DM-adjudicated by an explicit adjudicated clause. If a newly-ready operation would execute something unfaithful, do not land the hook that enables it; report it.

CONFORMANCE TESTS (exercise the PACK records, not hand-built fixtures, where possible):
- Wings of Flying: manifest -> economy depleted, no availableAt while active; dismiss-wings -> availableAt = dismissal time + rolled 1d12h; reuse refused before, permitted after reset; full 1-hour expiry path via clock advance schedules from the timer deadline, including a clock advance that overshoots the deadline (nonzero elapsed); initial creation does not schedule.
- grant-ended function path on Ring of Djinni and Efreeti Bottle records (direct call): schedules 24h; repeat event / non-awaiting does nothing; unknown grantId fails closed.
- Initiation-anchored (Frost Brand or Well of Many Worlds 1d8): behaviour unchanged.
- Soft limit via pack records: Ring of X-ray Vision first use spends, reuse at zero permitted with 0 spend, long rest restores; Wind Fan same with dawn.
- Fail-closed: dice duration without rng.

Run npm run verify:worktree before committing. Completion notes: design as built, hooks landed/not landed with reasons, exact ready delta with per-operation faithfulness note, staged grant-ended successor owner olc5.12.
notes:
Dispatched gpt-6-luna effort high from e25b29cd; PGID 3787148.
Completion report (2026-10-14; commit 5ba94d2a). Implemented event-anchored cooldown scheduling from depleted item state. useItem now leaves anchored cooldowns without availableAt until the matching state-entered event; operation transitions schedule at current elapsed time and timer transitions schedule at the timer deadline. applyItemCooldownAnchorEvent provides the grant-ended path, matches only declared anchors, does nothing for non-awaiting or already scheduled economies, and fails closed for unknown anchors or dice durations without seeded RNG. Grant-ended integration is staged: olc5.12 owns the live grant lifecycle and must call this function on grant end.

Hooks landed: F5 elapsed-time cooldown reset (spend-time schedule and deadline recharge); F5 state-anchored cooldown reset (operation and timer state-entry boundaries); F7 long-rest reset and early-reuse gate (Ring of X-ray Vision safe-use count); F5 dawn reset with nonblocking early-reuse risk (Wind Fan). The runtime spends a safe use while available, permits reuse at zero with zero further spend, and resets the safe-use pool. F5 grant-anchored cooldown reset was not landed because no live grant lifecycle exists; Ring of Djinni Summoning and Efreeti Bottle remain engine-pending for this hook.

Readiness delta measured over all item x variant x operation combinations: 19 to 23, four new ready operations. Frost Brand / extinguish-flames: the one-hour cooldown is runtime-owned; the exact activation sentence remains DM-adjudicated. Ring of X-ray Vision / activate-x-ray-vision: safe-use count and long-rest reset are runtime-owned; the sense is typed, and the exact DC 15 save and exhaustion risk is explicitly DM-adjudicated. Rod of Security / enter-paradise: the ten-day cooldown is runtime-owned; the full paradise ability remains in an explicit adjudicated source-text clause. Well of Many Worlds / open-portal: the 1d8-hour cooldown is runtime-owned; portal and destination behavior remain in an explicit adjudicated source-text clause. No newly-ready operation executes an unowned printed behavior.

Pack regenerated through importer. verify:dnd5e-srd-pack and inventory-semi-structured-boundary.ts --check pass. npm run verify:worktree passes: 361 test files passed, 2 skipped; 6753 tests passed, 3 skipped. Follow-up ownership for the staged grant-ended lifecycle is existing bead eshyra-olc5.12; no additional follow-up bead was needed. Commit is local on eshyra-olc5.8.1; no push or PR.
